pinev: Placed from the source text: GNIS Grundy Center
The county poor farm where he died in Aug 1907 was in N sec 22 Palermo Twp, about 2 mi SW of town (1911 atlas); the house that was searched was in Grundy Center, so the pin stays on the town.
Grundy Co papers 1907-08 are not indexed on newspapers.com; no follow-up found.

set.tovw: Lead grade F: by his own account the hoard was stolen from the hut in 1907; nothing is reported left
set.pl: Webster City; Lempke's hut stood east of town, site not located
set.t: Hut east of town, robbed 1907 while he was away; nothing known to remain. Record only.

tw-ia-webster-city-lempke-hut-1906.st: In Dec 1907 Edward Lempke, back after ten months at his daughter's in Des Moines, found his 'little hovel east of town' shattered and his belongings gone, and said he had been 'wrongfully relieved of some $1,500 worth of valuables', which he would not describe; he planned to prosecute.
